Tarun Hegde

tarun.hegde32@example.com | +91 9997249914

Summary
Frontend Engineer focused on building performant, accessible web experiences using modern React and TypeScript stacks. Comfortable delivering end-to-end features from design handoff to production, collaborating with product and backend teams. Currently contributing to payments-facing frontends with emphasis on maintainability and performance.

Experience
Razorpay — Feb 2025 - Present
Frontend Engineer (Hybrid)
- Implemented new ReactJS TypeScript components for the merchant dashboard, improving page load time by 28% through code-splitting and Webpack bundle optimization using dynamic imports and tree-shaking; collaborated with backend to migrate endpoints with Next.js incremental static regeneration.
- Led CSS refactor across checkout flows to reduce layout shift and improve CLS by 35%; introduced a component-level CSS system and consistent utility classes to speed up development and reduce regressions.
- Built state management patterns using Redux and TypeScript for complex payments state, reducing bug reports related to race conditions by 40% and enabling reliable retry flows for failed transactions.
- Drove cross-functional tracking in Jira, created detailed tickets and acceptance criteria for sprint planning, and mentored junior engineers on ReactJS best practices and TypeScript typings during code reviews.

Projects
Merchant Analytics Widget (Razorpay side project)
- Developed a reusable Next.js widget written in TypeScript and ReactJS that surfaces key metrics for small merchants; optimized server-side rendering and reduced client CPU usage by 22% on load.
- Packaged the widget with a lightweight Webpack configuration and documented integration steps in internal Wiki tracked via Jira tickets.
